anomalies.observed: J5 is a 2-pin screw terminal whose pin 2 is connected to the /Microcontroller/HEATER net, which is the ESP32 GPIO1 control signal driving U6 IN and DIAG_EN. J5 pin 1 is connected to GND. The specification does not mention J5; it only describes J6 as the heater connector (U6 OUT pin 7 to J6 pin 2).
anomalies.expected: The heater control signal should not be exposed on a screw terminal. The only heater connector should be J6 on the switched 12 V output (U6 OUT).

evidence.quote: OUT (pin 7) feeds the heater connector J6 pin 2

anomalies.impact: An external connection to J5 can load or short the ESP32 GPIO1 heater control signal to ground, potentially disabling the heater or damaging the MCU. This is an unintended extra connector on a sensitive control net.

parsed.summary: The design files contain an extra screw terminal J5 connected directly to the ESP32 GPIO1 heater control net, which is not present in the specification and could allow external interference or shorting of the heater control signal.
